answer: An agent marketplace requires every identity to lock 100 dollars in escrow for 30 days before it can bid for work, whether selling island maps, shale surveys, or onyx appraisals. Each identity gets one active bid slot, so creating 10,000 fake agents requires locking up a million dollars. The bond does not prove identities are unique; it makes multiplying their access costly by tying up capital for a fixed period.
